articles.title: Fifa to confirm UK as host for 2035 Women's World Cup
articles.summary: Fifa is set to confirm on Monday that a first football World Cup will be hosted in the United Kingdom since 1966.

articles.title: Thitikul wins CME Group Tour Championship for third year in a row
articles.summary: Jeeno Thitikul has won the LPGA Tour's season-ending CME Group Tour Championship for a third consecutive year after storming to a two-shot victory in Florida.
